create_templates_from_seq_and_a3m: create Templates from a query sequence and MSA A3M by running hmmsearch against a PDB structure database
create_templates_from_hmmsearch_a3m: create Templates from an existing hmmsearch A3M result string using a structure store to fetch PDB data
filter_template_hits: filter template hits by release date cutoff, alignment ratio, hit length, and deduplicate sequences
featurize_templates: featurize filtered template hits into stacked numpy arrays of atom positions, masks, sequences, and ligand features
run_hmmsearch_with_a3m: run hmmsearch against a PDB database using an A3M MSA and return the A3M string of template hits
